MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hook and loop strips fit my earlier use of reclosable fasteners: I can use them to mount small project components and remove them later.",
    "The magnet wire connects to my ferrite toroid cores through a specific activity—experimenting with coils—even though the spool is larger than I likely need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing relates to electrical work, but its 30mm diameter seems poorly suited to my small breadboard projects.",
    "Owning a temperature measuring tool does not mean I currently need a controller to automate heating or cooling.",
    "The pipe fitting, cotter pins, duct clamps and cutting wheels require particular projects or tools that my history does not establish. The screws and washers also need matching dimensions before I would choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in workshop supplies, while I choose supplies for particular tasks.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been stretched into a need for other mounting hardware, without evidence that those parts fit the same job."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is how an item works with parts I already have, such as wire for winding my toroid cores or removable fasteners for mounting components.",
    "Dimensions, tool compatibility and quantity affect whether I can actually use an item; a related purpose alone is not enough.",
    "My purchases are spread across years, so an older project does not necessarily describe what I need now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in practical projects but often assumed a specific current need from a broad connection to past purchases."
}
